Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.rmi.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualView
The RmiClient class represents the client-side implementation for RMI communication in the application. It extends UnicastRemoteObject to enable remote object functionality. This class acts as a listener for server-side calls, receiving updates and interactions from the RMI server. It serves as a bridge between the RMI server and the client's local model (ClientModel), forwarding server-side calls to the appropriate client-side logic for processing and UI rendering.
